          Emma Marie Cryer on the importance of the Open in OpenRouter
          
          
With so many AI models to choose from, why should developers have to commit to just one? Scott talks with Emma Marie Cryer from OpenRouter about making AI models more accessible, giving developers more choice, and avoiding lock-in as the AI landscape evolves. They explore what it means to build applications that can work across different models and providers, why the best model isn't always the biggest or most expensive, and how openness, competition, and flexibility are shaping the next generation of AI-powered software. Because the future of AI might not be about picking the winning model, but having the chance to use the right one for the job.
